# Hash-pinned install of dco-check, used by the dco-check job in .github/workflows/dco.yaml.
#
# dco-check has no transitive dependencies, so the version pin already settles
# which version is installed. The hashes are here for artifact integrity:
# --only-binary :all: selects a wheel but never verifies its digest, so
# without --require-hashes a compromised index or CDN could serve a different
# artifact under this filename.
#
# Every wheel hash published for this version is listed, so the install stays
# valid as the job's floating `python-version: '3.x'` moves between
# interpreter versions and platform wheel variants.
#
# Regenerate after a version bump: collect every bdist_wheel sha256 for the
# new version from https://pypi.org/pypi/dco-check/<version>/json

dco-check==0.5.1 \
    --hash=sha256:2ae255242d9b83722dd75a44ad8eebffb83f5d4cabf5e4b5d24c4b194437b3a5
